description: An expander for BufferSludger that plays its buffer at a pitch, adding its own automation to whatever is at that module's automation input; it goes on either side of it

params.text: Plays the buffer backwards when set to enable, unless the REVERSE CTRL jack is patched, which takes the setting over
Chooses what a change of pitch does: add carries on from the position already reached, reset starts the buffer again from the beginning

inputs.text: Holding 5V or more here plays the buffer backwards and overrides the REVERSE switch, despite the maker's tooltip naming this jack Reset
Sets the playback speed at two to the power of the voltage in direct mode, and at two to the power of one volt less, less a half, in wrap mode, where 0V then adds nothing

notes: with no BufferSludger on either side of it this module does nothing and the CONNECTED lamp stays dark
a second lamp lights whenever the playback is reversed
there is no output jack: the automation worked out here is handed to the BufferSludger beside it and added to that module's automation input

inputs.0:
high above 5V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the REVERSE switch; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
